_about: The subscribe route's shape, for the links content-engine now writes into finished words (the captions step and the Saturday Note; Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-26: content-engine makes every asset, captions included). Growth owns the route: growth-makeyourmindup specs/subscribe-route.json (mymu-subscribe-route/1) and engine/route.py subscribe_url, item_content and edition_url (growth PR 144). Growth's file is vendored byte for byte at vendor/makeyourmindup/subscribe-route.json and scripts/post-pack/subscribe_links.py reads it; this file holds the lines and places, and the weekly edition's `edition` block until content-engine PR 979 brings it into the vendored copy (built from the contract shape in the shared edition-contract.md, 25 Nov 2026). tests/subscribe_links_test.py fails if the two ever disagree.
